description: This Java source file implements the LoanDelinquencyDomainService interface, providing methods to compute overdue collection data and delinquency data for loans in a financial application. It handles detailed calculations of overdue amounts, delinquency durations, and integrates business rules such as grace periods and pausing of delinquency days.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyDomainServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing loan delinquency calculations, including overdue collection data and delinquency data, considering various business rules and integrating transaction history.

methods.name: getOverdueCollectionData
methods.description: Calculates overdue collection data including the total overdue amount, overdue days, delinquency dates, and separates overdue installments, considering grace periods and paused delinquency days.

methods.name: getLoanDelinquencyData
methods.description: Computes overall loan delinquency data, including overdue amounts and delinquency duration, at the loan level with optional installment-level details.

methods.name: getInstallmentOverdueCollectionData
methods.description: Calculates delinquency data for individual loan installments, considering whether they are overdue or not, and including chargeback transactions.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyDataForOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Computes delinquency details for an overdue installment, including overdue date, amounts, and handling chargeback transactions.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyDataForNonOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Calculates delinquency data for installments not yet overdue, considering chargeback transactions before the due date.

methods.name: calculateAndSetDelinquentDays
methods.description: Determines the number of delinquent days, factoring in overdue days, grace period, and any paused days due to effective delinquency pause policies.
